description: Human-readable health REPORT for a finished ZPL label with a 0-100 score, sectioned (syntax, size/DPI, orientation, barcodes, fonts, memory): only assessable sections count, the rest say 'not assessed'. Use it to review or explain a label to a person; for a quick pass/fail check while editing use zpl_validate. Pass the real label size — findings depend on it.

dpmm.description: Printer density in dots per mm (6, 8, 12 or 24)

model.description: Optional printer model as manufacturer/model (e.g. zebra/zd421) to add a model-compatibility section

name: explain_zpl
